name: openbot
description: Open-source, self-hosted, BYO-API-key GitHub maintenance bot for individual OSS maintainers.

OPENBOT_GITHUB_WEBHOOK_SECRET.description: HMAC-SHA-256 secret set when creating the GitHub App. Without it /webhook/github responds 503.

OPENBOT_GITHUB_APP_ID.description: Numeric App ID from the GitHub App settings page. Required for write-back (reply / labels).

OPENBOT_GITHUB_APP_PRIVATE_KEY_PEM.description: PEM-encoded private key as a literal string (begins with '-----BEGIN'). Use `heroku config:set OPENBOT_GITHUB_APP_PRIVATE_KEY_PEM="$(cat key.pem)"`. Mutually exclusive with OPENBOT_GITHUB_APP_PRIVATE_KEY_PATH; pem wins.

OPENBOT_REDIS_URL.description: Upstash Redis URL (rediss://...). Used for webhook dedup, rate limit, and the workflow queue.

OPENBOT_POSTGRES_URL.description: Neon Postgres URL using the asyncpg driver: postgresql+asyncpg://USER:PASS@HOST/DB?sslmode=require. Required for cost tracking + audit log.

OPENBOT_WORKER_CONCURRENCY.description: asyncio consumer tasks per worker process. Eco dyno (512MB) — keep at 4 unless you've profiled memory.

OPENBOT_DEBUG.description: Verbose logs. Never enable in production.

ANTHROPIC_API_KEY.description: Anthropic key for the agent's primary model (litellm picks it up from env).

OPENAI_API_KEY.description: OpenAI key — optional fallback / judge model.

LANGSMITH_API_KEY.description: LangSmith key for tracing / experiments. Without it traces fall back to stdout.

DAYTONA_API_KEY.description: Daytona API key for the agent sandbox backend (OPENBOT_SANDBOX_BACKEND=daytona).

OPENBOT_SANDBOX_BACKEND.description: Sandbox factory selector — daytona | modal | docker. Heroku has no docker daemon, so use daytona.

PYTHONUNBUFFERED.description: Flush stdout/stderr immediately so Heroku logs surface in real time.
